{{Top|leg}}
'''Microfilament grids''' were a form of technology used by the [[Ssi-ruu]]k. The grids could absorb a portion of incoming energy, such as weapons fire, and channel it into a [[Power generator/Legends|power generator]]. The Ssi-Ruuk's [[Swarm-class battle droid|''Swarm''-class battle droids]] were covered in microfilament grids.<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>
